RebelABTesting.TagDescription: Runs the experiments of this website that are in progress. Add it once, with a trigger that fires on every page.
RebelABTesting.TagMatomoOriginDescription: The address of your Matomo, for example https://analytics.example.org or https://example.org/matomo. The tag fetches the experiments from it.
RebelABTesting.TagMatomoOriginInvalid: The address of Matomo must start with https:// or http://.
RebelABTesting.ErrorNameTooLong: The name of the experiment can be 255 characters at most.
RebelABTesting.ErrorNameExists: The website already has an experiment with this name.
RebelABTesting.ErrorDateFormat: The dates must be given as YYYY-MM-DD.
RebelABTesting.ErrorDateOrder: The first day must not be after the last day.
RebelABTesting.ExperimentNotFound: This experiment could not be found. It may have been deleted.
RebelABTesting.FormHypothesisHint: What you expect and why, for example “A green button gets more clicks.”
RebelABTesting.TagHideTimeout: Hide the page for at most (milliseconds)
RebelABTesting.TagHideTimeoutDescription: On a visitor's first page the tag has to fetch the experiments. The page is hidden meanwhile, so that the original does not flash before a variant. 0 never hides the page.
RebelABTesting.ErrorTrafficShare: The share of visitors must be between 1 and 100.
RebelABTesting.ErrorTargetValue: Give the address to compare with, at most 1000 characters.
RebelABTesting.ErrorVariants: An experiment needs between 1 and 10 variants.
RebelABTesting.FormTargetValueHint: Compared with the whole address of the page, including https://.
RebelABTesting.FormTrafficShare: Share of visitors in the experiment (%)
RebelABTesting.FormTrafficShareHint: These visitors are split evenly between the original and the variants. The others get the original and are not counted.
RebelABTesting.FormVariantsHelp: A variant changes the page for the visitors who get it.
RebelABTesting.ListResultsHelp: Each experiment has a page with its result in the menu.
RebelABTesting.ResultChance: Chance to be better than the original
RebelABTesting.ResultNoConversions: No visit in the experiment has reached a goal yet.
RebelABTesting.ResultHelp: A variant is called better or worse on the primary measure and the guardrails when the chance is at least %s%%. The goals below them are shown without a verdict: with many measures, one of them gets there by chance more often. Goals, revenue and events count from the moment a visit is in the experiment.
RebelABTesting.ResultPreviewHelp: A link shows its variant in your browser until you close the tab, whatever the state of the experiment. The visit is not counted. Anyone with the link can see the variant.
RebelABTesting.ResultHelpNoPrimaryGoal: A variant is called better or worse when the chance is at least %s%%. This experiment has no primary measure, so every goal is judged, and one of several gets there by chance more often. Goals, revenue and events count from the moment a visit is in the experiment.
RebelABTesting.ErrorDoor: A fake door needs a text, a message after the click and the element it is put next to. The CSS class can only have letters, digits, spaces, - and _.
RebelABTesting.PlannerTitle: Work out how long to run
RebelABTesting.PlannerHelp: An experiment that is ended on the first good day often shows a difference that is not there. Work out the days here, and set the last day accordingly. Nothing in this section is saved.
RebelABTesting.PlannerVisits: Visits a day on the pages of the experiment
RebelABTesting.PlannerRate: Share of visits that reach the primary measure today (%)
RebelABTesting.PlannerEffectHint: 10 means: a variant that converts 10% more often than the original. Smaller differences take much longer to find.
RebelABTesting.PlannerResult: Run for at least %1$s days: %2$s visits in each of the %3$s groups. With that, a difference of this size is found four times out of five.
RebelABTesting.PlannerUnknown: Fill in the three numbers to see the days.
RebelABTesting.DoorHelp: The button or link is added to the page for the visitors in the experiment. A click shows your message in its place and is counted.
RebelABTesting.DoorLabel: Text of the button or link
RebelABTesting.DoorMessageHint: Tell the visitor that this does not exist yet, for example “We are working on this. Thank you for showing interest.”
RebelABTesting.DoorSelector: Put it next to the element (CSS selector)
RebelABTesting.DoorSelectorHint: For example #main-menu or .product-actions. Nothing is shown or counted on pages without the element.
RebelABTesting.DoorCssClassHint: A class of your website, so that it looks like your other buttons or links.
RebelABTesting.DoorResultHelp: The range is where the true share lies with 95% confidence. It narrows as more visits see it.
RebelABTesting.ResultSplitUneven: The visitors are not split evenly between the groups, far more unevenly than chance explains. Visitors are probably not assigned or counted as they should be, for example because a variant breaks the page or the tracking. Do not trust the result until this is found.
RebelABTesting.ErrorChange: A change needs an element and, except for hiding, a value. A class can only have letters, digits, - and _, an address must be on the website or start with https://, and a variant can have 20 changes at most.
RebelABTesting.ChangesHelp: An element is given as a CSS selector, for example h1 or .buy-button. Each change does one thing to the elements that match.
RebelABTesting.ErrorMeasure: A measure is a goal of this website, an event with a category, or one of the other choices of the form.
RebelABTesting.FormPrimaryMeasureHint: What the experiment is judged by. Choose it before the start: a variant that is only called better on the measure that happens to look best has often just been lucky.
RebelABTesting.FormGuardrailHint: Something that must not get worse while the primary measure gets better, for example orders or bounces.
RebelABTesting.ErrorWatch: Give the element to watch as a CSS selector, at most 500 characters.
RebelABTesting.WatchHelp: Nothing on the page is changed. A visit is counted when the element comes into view, and when it is clicked. Use it to learn how much an element is used, before you test a change to it.
RebelABTesting.WatchSelectorHint: For example .newsletter-signup or #main-menu a.pricing. All elements that match are watched as one.
RebelABTesting.ErrorRedirect: The page a variant sends to must be on the website or start with https://.
RebelABTesting.Action_insert_first: Insert a text at its top
RebelABTesting.Template_button_text: Change the text of a button
RebelABTesting.Template_button_look: Change the colour of a button
RebelABTesting.Template_banner: Show a banner at the top
RebelABTesting.Template_trust_line: Add a line of text after a button
RebelABTesting.Template_sticky_button: Keep a button on the screen
RebelABTesting.RedirectAddress: Send the visitor to this page instead
RebelABTesting.RedirectHint: For a test between two pages. Leave empty to change the page with the changes above. Limit the experiment to the page of the original, so that the other page is not part of it.
RebelABTesting.KindHelp_ab: Compare variants of a page with the original.
RebelABTesting.KindHelp_fake_door: Add a button to something that does not exist yet, and see how many want it.
RebelABTesting.KindHelp_watch: Change nothing. Count the visits that see and click something on the page.
RebelABTesting.TagHelp: Add the tag "Rebel A/B Testing" once to a container in Matomo Tag Manager, with a trigger that fires on every page, and publish the container. The tag runs every experiment of the website that is in progress.
RebelABTesting.ErrorConfidence: How sure to be must be 90, 95 or 99.
RebelABTesting.FormConfidenceHint: A variant is called better or worse when the chance is at least this high. Higher needs more visits.
RebelABTesting.EvolutionHelp: Each line is the result of a variant from the first day up to that day. Lines that still cross have not settled.
RebelABTesting.FormNotifyHint: An email to the one who adds the experiment, when a variant is found better or worse on the primary measure, and when the experiment has ended.
RebelABTesting.MailResult: Your experiment "%s" has a result on its primary measure. It is still running.
RebelABTesting.MailNoResult: no result, as it has no primary measure or no visits
RebelABTesting.ErrorAudience: The audience is not valid. A language is a code such as sv or en-gb, and a campaign or referrer has 200 characters at most.
RebelABTesting.AudienceHelp: Who the experiment is for. A visitor is checked when first meeting the experiment, and stays in or out after that.
RebelABTesting.AudienceCampaign: Came through a campaign whose name contains
RebelABTesting.AudienceCampaignHint: The campaign of the address the visit started on, as Matomo reads it: mtm_campaign, utm_campaign or pk_campaign.
RebelABTesting.AudienceReferrer: Came from an address that contains
RebelABTesting.AudienceReferrerHint: The page that led to the website, for example a search engine or a partner.
RebelABTesting.AudienceLanguagesHint: Language codes with commas between them. sv also takes sv-fi.
RebelABTesting.AudienceReferrerIs: came from an address that contains "%s"
RebelABTesting.ErrorRollOut: Only a variant of an A/B test can be shown to everyone.
RebelABTesting.KindHelp_rollout: Show a change to a share of the visitors, or to an audience, and count the rest without it.
RebelABTesting.RolloutShare: Share of visitors that get the change (%)
RebelABTesting.RolloutShareHint: Start low and raise it to roll a change out step by step. 100 shows it to everyone in the audience. Below 100, the rest are counted without the change, to compare with.
RebelABTesting.RollOutHint: Ends this test and starts a rollout of the variant, for the same pages and audience, for a year. Change the website itself within that time.
RebelABTesting.RolledOut: The variant is now shown to everyone, and the test has ended.
RebelABTesting.ErrorDecision: The decision is not one of the choices, or its note is longer than 2000 characters.
RebelABTesting.DecisionWhyHint: For whoever looks at this experiment in a year.
